title.es: Aquel del trato de las Islas Canarias
title.en: The One With the Canary Islands Deal

description.es: Damián le dice a Marta que le ofreció dinero a Santiago a cambio de que retirara la denuncia, enviándolo a las Islas Canarias, y que Santiago aceptó. Marta se enfada porque no ha podido vengarse. Marta y Fina hablan sobre Claudia en la tienda. Fina dice que van a ir a la playa para animar a Claudia. Invita también a Marta, pero Marta dice que no puede ir.
description.en: Damián tells Marta that he offered Santiago money in exchange for withdrawing his complaint, sending him to the Canary Islands, and that Santiago accepted. Marta is angry that she could not get her revenge. Marta and Fina talk about Claudia at the store. Fina says that they are going to go to the beach to make Claudia happy. She invites Marta too, but Marta says she cannot come.
